course.title: French for Beginners
course.tagline: Speak French from zero: greetings, sentences and real conversations.

days.title: Say bonjour and hello
days.goal: Greet people in French and say goodbye.
steps: Watch today's video and repeat every example of greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir out loud as you hear it.
Practise greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir aloud for 10 minutes, slowly first, then at normal speed.
Write down five of your own examples using greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir.
Record yourself practising greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir and listen back, fixing any mistakes you hear.
Use greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir in a real exchange today — with a friend, family member or language partner.
days.task: Say bonjour, bonsoir, salut and au revoir out loud five times each.
days.challenge: Greet someone in French today, even by message.

quiz.q: What does 'bonjour' mean?
quiz.explain: 'Bonjour' means hello or good day. It is the most common French greeting.

quiz.q: Which of these is the goal of today's lesson?
options: Hold a short greeting chat in French.
Greet people in French and say goodbye.
Name foods and say what you like.
Ask where a place is in French.
quiz.explain: Today's lesson is about Say bonjour and hello — its goal is: Greet people in French and say goodbye.

quiz.q: Which of these did today's lesson focus on?
options: the French alphabet and its sounds
saying where you are from: Je suis de... / J'habite à...
describing people: grand, petit, gentil, drôle
greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir
quiz.explain: Today's focus was greetings: bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir.
